documented_exclusions: TMP117 ALERT is intentionally unavailable and grounded. TI TMP117 datasheet section 8.2.1 explicitly permits grounding ALERT when unused. Open-drain pin type retained; this exact marker is contention with the external GND PWR_FLAG, not a driven-high circuit.

LIS2DH12 SDO/SA0 is grounded to select I2C address 0x18 with CS high, as specified in ST datasheet section 6.1.1. Bidirectional type retained for its SPI role. Only this exact GND PWR_FLAG marker is excluded. Firmware follow-up: disable internal SDO pull-up using CTRL_REG0 SDO_PU_DISC while preserving required other bits.
